answer: Each agent must lock a refundable bond before claiming a task reward, and withdrawal waits until independent work checks finish. If audits show that one operator split its claims across Sybil accounts, the protocol slashes the bond behind them; creating more identities therefore means risking more real capital. This makes a voyage of fabricated personas expensive: funds are immobilized and may be lost for every claim. Public review rules and an audit trail make detection credible.
